brief:
An Israeli government agency is sponsoring U.S. Senator Ted Cruz's podcast without clear public disclosure to listeners, the Quincy Institute reported. The financial arrangement raises questions about foreign government involvement in American political media and whether the deal complies with federal transparency and lobbying disclosure requirements.

The sponsorship deal involves an Israeli entity providing financial support for the podcast's production and distribution. Details about the terms of the agreement, the amount of funding involved, and the extent of Israeli government influence over editorial decisions remain unclear. Cruz has not publicly detailed the arrangement or addressed potential conflicts of interest arising from the foreign government backing.
title: Israel funds Ted Cruz podcast through undisclosed arrangement
